touch_layout._move_stick_note: Which move stick the touch HUD builds. 'virtual' (the default) = Godot 4.7 VirtualJoystick; 'custom' = the hand-written stick, kept as a working fallback. The player profile (Settings in the main menu) overrides this value. See docs/CONTROLS.md and OQ-VJOY.
touch_layout._vjoy_layout_note: Only used when move_stick is 'virtual'. 'floating' (default): JOYSTICK_DYNAMIC, a touch anywhere in the left half (move_zone) spawns the base under the thumb. 'fixed': JOYSTICK_FIXED at move_stick_rest, only touches on the stick grab it; other touches go to look.
